name: ROBUST III
aliases: Re-Establishing Flow Via Drug Coated Balloon For The Treatment Of Urethral Stricture Disease
question: Does paclitaxel-coated balloon dilation improve stricture patency over standard endoscopic dilation or urethrotomy in men with recurrent short anterior urethral strictures?

arms.label: Optilume paclitaxel-coated balloon dilation after predilation
standard endoscopic management (uncoated balloon, urethral sounds or DVIU)

design.population: 127 men with recurrent anterior urethral strictures of 3 cm or less and at least 2 prior endoscopic treatments.
design.locator: PMC12721643 Abstract; Study Design and Participants; Randomization and Blinding; Table 1

verdictNote: Superior at 6 months; control arm unblinded after 6 months and followed only 1 year.
takeaway: In men with recurrent anterior urethral strictures of 3 cm or less after at least two endoscopic treatments, Optilume paclitaxel-coated balloon dilation improved 6-month anatomical success over standard dilation or urethrotomy (74.6% versus 26.8%) and 1-year freedom from repeat intervention (83.2% versus 21.7%).

reports.label: 1-year randomized report
reports.citation: Elliott SP, Coutinho K, Robertson KJ, et al. "One-Year Results for the ROBUST III Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating the Optilume® Drug-Coated Balloon for Anterior Urethral Strictures." *J Urol.* 2022;207(4):866-875. doi:10.1097/JU.0000000000002346
reports.followUp: 1 year (primary endpoint at 6 months; control arm followed to 1 year only)
reports.followUpLocator: PMC12721643 Interventions and Followup; Outcome Measures

results.measure: 6-month anatomical success (16 Fr flexible cystoscope or 14 Fr catheter passed atraumatically), complete-case counts; difference in percentage points (DCB minus control) from multiple imputation
results.note: Repeat intervention before 6 months counted as failure (2 DCB, 18 control); cystoscopy was missing in 12 DCB and 7 control patients. The Table 2 footnote describes the p value as 1-sided; Methods specify a 2-sided 0.05 test.

results.measure: 6-month anatomical success if all 12 missing DCB patients failed and all 7 missing control patients succeeded
results.note: Worst-case sensitivity analysis described by the authors.

results.measure: 6-month anatomical success, subset treated with a 30 Fr balloon (70 DCB, 11 control)
results.note: Subset analysis comparing the 11 control patients dilated with a 30 Fr uncoated balloon with the 70 DCB patients; the p value is as reported.

results.measure: Kaplan–Meier freedom from repeat dilation, DVIU or urethroplasty at 1 year
results.note: Log-rank comparison. Later reports cite 23.6% for the control arm at 1 year.

results.measure: Mean Qmax at 1 year (mL/s); baseline 7.6 (n=78) DCB and 7.4 (n=47) control
results.note: The abstract lists Qmax as a key secondary endpoint; the report gives group means without a between-group test. Control values rose to 30 days and fell from 3 months.

results.measure: Mean IPSS at 1 year; baseline 22.0 (n=79) DCB and 22.8 (n=47) control
results.note: The abstract lists IPSS as a key secondary endpoint; the report gives group means without a between-group test.

harms.label: Primary safety composite through 3 months (urethral fistula, unresolved de novo stress incontinence or urethral rupture)
harms.locator: PMC12721643 Safety Results; Table 1 group sizes
harms.note: No participant had a primary safety event.

harms.label: Post-procedure hematuria
harms.note: Reported together with dysuria as 11.4% versus 2.1% for both event types; judged mild.

harms.label: Dysuria
harms.note: Hematuria and dysuria resolved within 30 days in 10 of 11 men.

harms.label: Serious adverse events
harms.note: One serious urinary tract infection was judged possibly related to the device or procedure in each group.

harms.label: Sexual function (IIEF)
harms.note: No change in IIEF in either group.

delivery.label: DCB-arm pretreatment
delivery.value: Pretreated to at least 20 Fr: uncoated balloon 92.4%, DVIU 5.1%, both 2.5%.
delivery.locator: PMC12721643 Interventions and Followup; Results after Table 1
delivery.note: Direct dilation with the DCB was avoided to prevent a second paclitaxel dose if the first dilation was inadequate.

delivery.label: DCB size and length
delivery.value: Most used diameter 30 Fr; length 30 mm 28.2%, 50 mm 60.8%.

delivery.label: DCB inflation and catheter
delivery.value: Inflated to rated burst pressure for at least 5 minutes (mean 8 minutes 42 seconds from insertion to removal); 12–14 Fr Foley placed after removal.
delivery.locator: PMC12721643 Interventions and Followup; Results after Table 1

delivery.label: Control treatment
delivery.value: Uncoated balloon 58.3% (24 Fr in 16, 28 Fr in 1, 30 Fr in 11), DVIU 25.0%, urethral sounds 16.7%.
delivery.note: No lumen-size goal was prespecified for the control arm.

delivery.label: Estimated post-treatment lumen
delivery.value: Mean 24 Fr in both groups (urethrography estimate).

delivery.label: Repeat intervention before 6 months
delivery.note: Includes control patients with confirmed recurrence who crossed over to the DCB.

delivery.label: Baseline stricture
delivery.value: Bulbar 92.1%; mean length 1.7 cm; mean 3.6 prior treatments; 23/127 (18.1%) with 5 or more.
delivery.note: Penile stricture 8/79 DCB and 2/47 control; prior pelvic radiation 9/79 and 6/48.

delivery.label: Paclitaxel in semen (nonrandomized pharmacokinetic cohort)
delivery.value: Detected in 9/15 (60%) at 30 days, 5/13 (39%) at 3 months and 1/12 (8.3%) at 6 months.
delivery.note: The authors recommend contraception through 6 months when the partner can conceive.

results.measure: Mean Qmax at 2 years in the DCB arm (mL/s; baseline 7.6); paired t test versus baseline

results.measure: Kaplan–Meier freedom from reintervention at 2 years, penile strictures (n=8)

results.endpoint: Freedom from repeat intervention, bulbar strictures

harms.note: Onset within 30 days in 9/12 events; mild in 11/12; resolved within 30 days in 10/12.

harms.note: Same events as the 1-year report. No additional treatment-related adverse events after 12 months.

harms.label: Erectile function (IIEF-EF, sexually active at baseline)

delivery.value: 30 Fr in 70, 24 Fr in 6, 36 Fr in 3.

delivery.value: 30, including 15 treatment failures and 2 non-study-related deaths.

Device- or procedure-related adverse events
